name: Lilith of Eshkalon
source:
Lilith of Eshkalon is by far the youngest member of the Class of Exemplary Acolytes. She specializes in Golemancy, more specifically, logic engines.

She is the daughter of Mehit of Eshkalon and the niece of Hamilcar of Kane.

[Edited from [url=https://everblossom.miraheze.org/wiki/Lilith_of_Eshkalon]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Wiki[/url]]
